## Type of change

- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] New feature / enhancement
- [ ] Skill content (SKILL.md / intake-schema.md)
- [ ] Tooling / CI / docs only
- [ ] Refactor (no behaviour change)

## Checklist

- [ ] `pytest` passes locally.
- [ ] `ruff check .` and `ruff format --check .` pass.
- [ ] `mypy` passes.
- [ ] New behaviour has tests; bug fixes include a regression test.
- [ ] User-visible changes are noted in `CHANGELOG.md` under `[Unreleased]`.
- [ ] No new runtime dependency (PyYAML is the only one — see CONTRIBUTING.md).
- [ ] If touching the schema, `intake-schema.md` and `SKILL.md` are updated together.
